answer: Require every agent identity to lock a separate 100-credit bond for 30 days before it can bid for work. The registry rejects any bond already assigned to another identity, so accounts named vertex, voyage, and comet each need their own deposit. An attacker adding one more fake must immobilize another 100 credits; at a 12% annual borrowing rate, that costs about 0.99 credits per month even if the bond is fully returned. Splitting into more names creates no cheaper entry.
